anyOf.description:
One probe as the UI and the MCP tools read it: ``_probe_summary`` (routes/management/probes.py).

Without its result totals: a route answering with one probe after a change (import, hub import,
arm, disarm, a behaviour's arm) passes none, and ``_probe_summary`` adds them only when given
(``if totals is not None``). The list and the detail carry them (`ProbeListItem`,
`ProbeIdentityDetail`).

``behaviour_of(definition)`` (core/probe_labels.py): the definition's ``behaviour``
block, cut to three keys. The route sends ``null`` instead when the block is absent, not an
object or has no usable ``key``.

schema.description:
Chat completion request - OpenAI format.

Supports all standard OpenAI chat completion parameters. Unknown fields are kept
(extra="allow") and reported or refused by `miserver/api/request_policy.py`.

items.description: Chat message with role and content.
items.title: ChatMessage

items.description: Chat message with role and content.
items.title: ChatMessage

oneOf.description: The output parses as one JSON object.
oneOf.title: ResponseFormatJsonObject

json_schema.description:
OpenAI's `json_schema` block. `strict: false` is accepted and the schema is STILL
enforced (FR-25.10.4): enforcing more than asked is not a silent drop.

`schema` is held as `schema_` because `schema` shadows a BaseModel attribute; requests are
never dumped, so the alias only matters on input. Unknown keys are refused (`forbid`), so a
misspelt field inside the block cannot be dropped silently.
json_schema.title: JsonSchemaSpec

anyOf.description:
`return_sae_activations` on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` (FR-27.1).

`positions` is absolute over the processed sequence (prompt, then generated tokens). The final
sampled token is never fed back, so it has no activation (FR-27.1c). `features` restricts the
candidates; `top_k` picks the largest among them, as the monitoring configuration does.
`{start, end}`: absolute positions over the processed sequence, half-open.
anyOf.title: PositionRange
ReturnSaeActivations

items.description:
One `{index, strength}` of an inline set. `strength` is clamped to ±200 at apply time
(FR-28.1.7) and the clamp is reported in `X-miLLM-Steering`, never silent.
items.title: InlineSteeringFeature

anyOf.title: InlineSteering

anyOf.description: `tool_choice: {"type": "function", "function": {"name": ...}}`: call exactly this one.
anyOf.title: ToolChoiceFunction

items.description: One entry of `tools` (function calling, 2026-10-28).

function.description: A function the model may call (OpenAI `tools[].function`).
function.title: ChatToolFunction

items.title: ChatTool

schema.title: ChatCompletionRequest

schema.description:
Non-streaming chat completion response.

The `id` format is "chatcmpl-{24 hex chars}".

items.description: Single completion choice in non-streaming response.
The scored next token (FR-25.8): `content` holds exactly one of these.
One entry of `top_logprobs` in OpenAI's chat logprobs shape.
items.title: ChatLogprobAlternative
ChatLogprobToken

message.description: Chat message with role and content.
message.title: ChatMessage

items.title: ChatCompletionChoice

anyOf.description: The `millm` object. Every field is optional and omitted when absent.
anyOf.title: MillmExtension

usage.description:
`usage` of a chat completion: `Usage` plus OpenAI's `completion_tokens_details`.

A subclass, not a field on `Usage`, so `/v1/completions` (whose response is in the vendored
scoring contract, `docs/schemas/millm-scoring-api-v1.json`) is unchanged.

anyOf.description:
OpenAI's breakdown of `completion_tokens`. miServer fills `reasoning_tokens` where it
counts the reasoning block itself (structured output on a GGUF model, 2026-11-21).
anyOf.title: CompletionTokensDetails

usage.title: ChatUsage
